meta.name: data-scientist
meta.description: Processes and analyzes data with resident-kernel engines (DuckDB, Polars) and one-shot tools. Use for CSV/parquet/JSON analysis, group-by/join/aggregation, time series, distributions, cleaning, or plotting a dataset.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析本地数据文件,快速获得统计汇总与图表。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要处理表格或 CSV 等数据文件,想快速做统计和示意图。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze local data files and quickly produce statistical summaries and charts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with spreadsheets or CSV data and want quick summaries and charts.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 DuckDB、Polars 等引擎分析数据文件(CSV、Parquet、JSON 等),做分组、连接、聚合等处理,也能清洗和绘图。它会先探查文件与内存,再决定载入内存还是流式处理;回答后只报告行数与耗时,不额外发挥。
howto.when: 当你要分析数据文件(如 CSV、Parquet 等),做分组、连接或绘图等操作时。

say.text: 帮我把这个 CSV 按月分组,统计每月销售额总和。
say.note: Claude 会用数据引擎直接查文件。

say.text: 分析这份 parquet,对比不同地区的平均订单金额。
say.note: 会先探测文件大小,再选执行方式。

say.text: 画一下这份数据里价格的分布直方图。
say.note: 会按附带的绘图规范出图并做视觉检查。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude analyzes data files (CSV/Parquet/JSON) with DuckDB/Polars: group-by, join, aggregate, clean, plot. It probes memory and file first, picks in-memory or streaming, and reports row counts and timing only.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to analyze data files like CSV/Parquet, or to group, join, or plot data.

say_en.text: Group this CSV by month and sum sales per month.
say_en.note: Claude queries the file with a data engine.

say_en.text: Analyze this parquet and compare average order amount by region.
say_en.note: It probes the file size first, then chooses how to run.

say_en.text: Plot a histogram of prices in this dataset.
say_en.note: It follows the bundled plotting spec and does a visual check.
